scope: Exercise mobile opacity.value and shadow.box through the real Inspector, Canvas, draft Save, Editor reload, explicit Publish and inheritance reset for every editable non-root PARTIAL type.

initial_regression.result: The first expanded run completed the new opacity/shadow lifecycle and failed at reset because the test fixture attempted to click a reset button inside a collapsed Inspector accordion.
initial_regression.classification: Test fixture visibility issue; no application assertion or renderer defect was observed before the timeout.

fixture_fix: Expand each opacity/shadow Inspector group before checking and activating its mobile inheritance reset.
coverage: All 44 editable non-root PARTIAL types expose opacity.value -> responsive.set / opacity and shadow.box -> responsive.set / boxShadow.
Distinct mobile opacity and shadow values render in Canvas and are stored in the correct Page Model breakpoint overrides.
Draft Save leaves published mobile CSS unchanged; both values survive Editor reload.
Explicit Publish applies the expected mobile computed opacity and shadow for all 44 types.
Mobile Publish leaves all 44 desktop computed opacity and shadow values unchanged.

Resetting each mobile value restores the desktop Canvas appearance; Save does not change the published mobile appearance, while separate Publish removes both public mobile overrides and restores inheritance.
